description: This file defines the EmployeeSubordinateAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing employee subordinate relationships within the HRM system. The class includes methods for listing, adding, retrieving, updating, and deleting subordinate records for a specific employee, utilizing various services and models. It also contains detailed annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: EmployeeSubordinateAPI
classes.description: A REST API class for managing employee subordinates, supporting listing, adding, retrieving, updating, and removing subordinate relationships for a specific employee within the HRM system.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list subordinates of a specific employee, applying sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new subordinate to an employee.

methods.name: setSubordinateParams
methods.description: Sets subordinate details from request parameters into a ReportTo entity.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove subordinates based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific subordinate's details.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update the reporting method of a subordinate.

methods.name: getUrlAttributes
methods.description: Extracts employee and subordinate IDs from URL parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getAll method.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the create method.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the delete method.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne method.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the update method.

methods.name: getEmpNumberRule
methods.description: Creates validation rule for employee number parameter.

methods.name: getReportingMethodIdRule
methods.description: Creates validation rule for reporting method ID parameter.

methods.name: getSubordinateIdsRule
methods.description: Creates validation rule for subordinate IDs array parameter.
